digest.component_or_area: rebar.llm public API / external live tests
propositions: The public API rebar.llm.review_ticket() was removed in a pre-1.0 breaking change (deprecated v0.11.0, removed 2026-08-12) and replaced with review_plan() and review_code()
External live test modules tests/external/test_pydantic_ai_cutover_live.py and tests/external/test_llm_trace.py still call the removed review_ticket() API and were missed during the removal epic
Four CI lanes in the external-integration.yml workflow fail with AttributeError: module 'rebar.llm' has no attribute 'review_ticket' when external tests run

The retarget from review_ticket() to review_plan() is not a mechanical rename because review_plan() lacks the positional graph-target argument and returns PLAN_REVIEW_VERDICT (no top-level findings) instead of REVIEW_RESULT

Both external test modules were successfully retargeted to rebar.llm.review_code() (the surviving op returning REVIEW_RESULT with runner/model/findings fields) and validated live in workflow_dispatch run 31856166064
